question_en: List the resolutions that drive changes to spec 38.331 (RRC decision impact).
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r.resolutionId LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'})
MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(agenda:AgendaItem)
RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt, agenda.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber, r.sequence AS sequence
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, agendaNumber ASC, sequence ASC, resolutionId ASC
